messages:
alex: Hey team — PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2891. Small TF change for ingress NLB health checks + a null_resource to force rollout. Can someone take a look? @priya @jin :eyes:

priya: On it. Which canary/environment is this hitting and what's failing today?

alex: Staging canary = ingress-canary-us-west2. After the last merge the LB target group showed 0/3 healthy and traffic returned 503s. Plan is to set health_check.path = "/_probe" and matcher = "200"; also change port to "traffic-port". Brief plan snippet:
```terraform
resource "aws_lb_target_group" "ingress_tg" {
  name = "ingress-tg"
  port = 80
  protocol = "HTTP"
  target_type = "ip"

  health_check {
    enabled  = true
    path     = "/_probe"
    port     = "traffic-port"
    matcher  = "200"
    interval = 10
  }
}
```

sam: Quick thought: looks fine. Two questions: 1) do we need a security group update so nodes accept health probes? 2) null_resource to force a new TG attachment is fine but add lifecycle ignore_changes for downstream stacks.

alex: Added SG egress rule for NLB health ranges and included `null_resource.wait_for_rollout` in the PR. Also added a `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [target_group_arn] }` tweak where appropriate.

jin: Can you add a short rollback plan in the PR description? If the health port changes it could break other consumers. Also request a 30m canary window and manual approval before global rollout.

alex: Done. Rollback steps documented: `terraform apply -var 'tg_healthcheck_path=/health' -target=aws_lb_target_group.ingress_tg` and rollback playbook link in PR. Canary window set to 30m and I've added the manual hold step.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary-deploy started for ingress-canary-us-west2 by alex at 2026-03-17T14:12:10Z

priya: Running `terraform fmt` and a plan check now. If the plan looks clean I'll approve.

sam: I'm fine with the change after priya's approval. @jin you'll be second sign-off for the canary?

jin: Yep, will watch the canary window.

priya: Approved. :thumbsup: Left 1 nit about a comment in the module, but not blocking.

alex: Thanks! Merging in 5m if no rollback. I'll monitor logs and health metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary-deploy finished — health checks 3/3 healthy, no 5xx spikes observed.

alex: Update: canary passed. Scheduling global rollout tomorrow morning within maintenance window. Will post a follow-up if anything pops up.
